verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 at https://increase.com/openapi.json, and the file contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The same probes found machine-readable llms.txt and markdown documentation endpoints alongside it. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec (its location, versioning, coverage), and evidence that the spec's completeness or accuracy has been checked against the live API.
